title: The Chiefs of Ten and their Secrets
heading: The Chiefs of Ten and their Secrets
summary: Lists the Technique and pair of Forms covered by the Secret of each known Watcher, which is the template for each Grigori Supernatural and Hermetic Virtue.
quotes: **Araquiel:** Creo, Terram, Corpus
**Shamsiel:** Rego, Ignem, Vim

title: Library Consultation
heading: Library Consultation
summary: Optional extended fact-finding research rules: a character spends a season consulting books on a single question, gaining temporary experience, then rolls against the question's Ease Factor. Suited to very hard questions.
quotes: a magus can consult a number of books on the relevant ability up to his Intelligence + Artes Liberales per season
At the end of the season, the magus rolls Intelligence plus the temporarily boosted Ability against the Ease Factor of the question.

title: Finding the Grigori: search Ease Factors
heading: Finding the Grigori
summary: Suggested Abilities and Ease Factors for quickly resolving the search for the Grigori relics and sites with simple Ability rolls instead of a full adventure.
quotes: Order of Hermes Lore, Ease Factor 12
Dominion Lore, Ease Factor 21

title: Heron's Art: Mechanica
heading: Heron's Art: Mechanica
requires: Virtue: Mechanica of Heron, or Hermetic integration of Heron's Mechanica
summary: Introduces the Mechanica of Heron Supernatural Virtue, how a Gifted character learns it from a surviving practitioner, and why a magus would rather integrate it into Hermetic theory.
quotes: A new Major Supernatural Virtue, Mechanica of Heron, represents the magical techniques described in this chapter.

title: Integrating Heron's Mechanica into Hermetic Theory
heading: Integrating Heron's Mechanica into Hermetic Theory
requires: Hermetic breakthrough research (Mutable Device and Awakened Device)
summary: Describes the two suggested Breakthroughs needed to fold Mechanica into Hermetic theory, and how uncorrupted texts and working mechanica give Insight and a one-time Lab Total bonus when inventing a matching device.
quotes: Integrating Heron's Mechanica requires the following two suggested Breakthroughs: Mutable Device and Awakened Device.
Mechanica provide a bonus equal to the magnitude of the device's effect.
related: Ancient Magic Introduction: Insight and breakthroughs

title: Ability: Mechanica of Heron
heading: Ability Mechanica of Heron
summary: The Supernatural Ability covering what mechanica are, how to build them and use them, mainly in the laboratory, with its suggested specialties.
quotes: Inventing Mechanica, Constructing Anima, working with a particular material.

title: Understanding Mechanica
heading: Understanding Mechanica
requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Heron's Mechanica
summary: A magus studies a mechanica for a season using the Investigating Enchantments rules to learn to use it as well as possibly gain Insight; also gives the accumulated breakthrough points suggested for Mutable Device.
quotes: Study Mechanica: Intellego Vim Lab Total + stress die vs. device spell or effect level
If the study total generated exceeds the level of the effect in the device, the magus understands the device sufficiently to use the device

title: Mechanica of Heron: constructing mechanica
heading: Major Supernatural Virtue: Mechanica of Heron
summary: How a Mechanician builds and alters ordinary mechanica in a laboratory: a creation total against a creation level based on the effect's magnitude, modifiers for size and time to employ, a cost in Mythic Pounds rather than vis, and a week's study to alter a device's effect.
quotes: Construct Mechanica of Heron Total: Intelligence + Mechanica of Heron Ability + (lower of Philosophiae or Artes Liberales) + aura
Mechanica Creation Level: (3 x Magnitude of Imbued Effect) + modifiers
Creating Mechanica Cost: 1 Mythic Pound per 3 points of Mechanica Creation Level
related: ArM5 p.187 auras and magical devices

title: Mechanica of Heron: awakened simulacra (anima)
heading: Major Supernatural Virtue: Mechanica of Heron, Continued
summary: Rules for building a simulacrum of an animal, working out its Magic Might from size and material, awakening its anima with a cumulative-bonus lab project, and playing the resulting sentient mechanica (traits, Abilities, powers of movement and speech).
quotes: Anima's Magic Might: Size + Material Base Points + (lower of Philosophiae or Artes Liberales)
Awaken Anima Total: Intelligence + Mechanica of Heron Ability + (lower of Philosophiae or Artes Liberales) + Aura
Awaken Anima Level: 9 + Magnitude of Anima's Magic Might
related: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.129 automata powers

title: Major Breakthrough: Mutable Device
heading: Major Breakthrough: Mutable Device
summary: Hermetic enchanted devices whose invested effect can be altered later in the laboratory using vis, as long as the new effect shares Form and Technique and does not exceed the original level.
quotes: A mutable item is created like a Lesser Enchanted Device with the new Mutable Device property adding +10 to the device's level of effect.
related: ArM5 p.110 shape and material bonuses

title: Integrating Mechanica: the integration process
heading: Integration Process
requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Heron's Mechanica
summary: After an Insight Lab Text exists, the magus makes Hermetic devices that duplicate a mechanica's effects to earn breakthrough points; building enchanted devices without vis breaks the Lesser Limit of Creation.
quotes: Incorporating the Mechanicians' ability to build enchanted devices without vis breaks the Lesser Limit of Creation (ArM5, page 80), requiring a Hermetic Breakthrough to achieve.
related: ArM5 p.80 Lesser Limit of Creation

title: Major Breakthrough: Awakened Device
heading: Major Breakthrough: Awakened Device
summary: The breakthrough that allows Hermetic magi to awaken enchanted devices; it is a Major Breakthrough unless Mutable Device has already been discovered, in which case it is Minor.
quotes: If the researcher has already discovered Mutable Device, she builds upon existing work and the discovery becomes a Minor Breakthrough requiring 30 points.

title: Major Hermetic Virtue: Awaken Device
heading: Major Hermetic Virtue: Awaken Device
requires: Virtue: Awaken Device (after the Awakened Device breakthrough)
summary: Hermetic procedure for awakening a simulacrum into a sentient Awakened Device: Magic Might from material and Magic Theory, vis cost, a Lab Total accumulated over uninterrupted seasons, and further enchanting for locomotion and communication.
quotes: Awakened Device's Magic Might: Material Base Points + Magic Theory
Awakened Device Lab Total: Creo + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura
Awakened Device Level: Awakened Device's Magical Might + (Size x 5)
related: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size Table

title: Entering the Temple of Serapis
heading: Entering the Temple
summary: The lost temple's regio is accessible only when the local Dominion aura drops below a threshold; characters carrying a mechanica enter automatically, and the window closes after a few hours.
quotes: When the Dominion aura dips below 4, the doorway to the Temple of Serapis appears as a ghostly archway of shadows beneath the lintel.

title: Ptolemaic coordinates versus Arcane Connections
heading: Consequences
requires: Ptolemaic coordinates integrated into Hermetic theory
summary: Explains how coordinates work as Arcane Connections that rely on the Law of Names: they do not fade, can be carried in the mind, written down or built into items, and can be shared without being lost.
quotes: They are information rather than objects, so they can be given away, and yet retained by the giver.
They do not need to be collected from a place, because they rely on the Law of Names, not the Law of Contagion.

title: Using Magical Coordinates
heading: Using Magical Coordinates
summary: Overview of integrating Ptolemaic coordinates into Hermetic magic: learn to measure the array of fixed stars, then calibrate the system by observing the array at the origin point. No new Virtue or Ability is needed and the technique can be taught.
quotes: As soon as a character has completed the tasks required to reconstruct Ptolemy's work, it can be applied immediately to Hermetic magic, and may be taught to others.

title: Deriving Coordinates
heading: Deriving Coordinates
summary: The three ways a character can learn the coordinates of a place (stellar observation, other astronomers' observations, spellcasting), and the note that known coordinates can be used day or night, indoors or underground.
quotes: A character does not require starlight to use coordinates; the character can use known coordinates during the day, from inside buildings, or underground.

title: Observation of the Fixed Stars
heading: Observation of the Fixed Stars
summary: How to derive a place's coordinates by astronomical observation: an Intelligence + Artes Liberales roll with a clear sky, simple tools and time for calculation (shortened by supernaturally accurate timepieces or Ptolemy's tables). It cannot work without the array of fixed stars at the origin.
quotes: A character who makes an Intelligence + Artes Liberales roll against an Ease Factor of 15 makes an accurate observation.

title: Learning Coordinates from Other Astronomers
heading: Learning Coordinates from Other Astronomers
summary: Coordinates can be taken from Ptolemy's published lists, but their accuracy varies by region, being excellent near Alexandria, often good within the old Western Roman Empire and poor beyond it.
quotes: His coordinates for places around Alexandria are perfect, and those within the borders of the fallen Western Roman Empire are often correct to within a few miles.

title: Stellar Measurement by Spellcasting
heading: Stellar Measurement by Spellcasting
requires: Ptolemaic coordinates plus the Celestial Magic Mystery
summary: Magi with the Celestial Magic Mystery can measure coordinates by spell instead of by eye; the sample spell shows the effect and notes how precisely a magus can hold a coordinate in mind.
quotes: A magus is unable to hold coordinates in her mind with sufficient precision to represent a circle less than 1000 paces across.
related: The Mysteries Revised Edition Chapter 6: Hermetic Astrology (Celestial Magic)

title: The Problem of the Origin Point
heading: The Problem of the Origin Point
summary: Characters cannot use the system until they know the array of fixed stars at the origin point, which they must infer from stellar readings, including one taken on the Zero Longitude in the Purple Islands.
quotes: The characters require three stellar readings.

title: Research on the Purple Islands
heading: Research
summary: Rolls and Ease Factors for what characters can learn about the Purple Islands from classical geography and Magic Lore before they sail.
quotes: An Intelligence + Artes Liberales roll, against an Ease Factor of 6, gives the following information:
An Intelligence + Magic Lore roll, against an Ease Factor of 9, gives the following information:

title: The Code of Hermes and the Guan
heading: The Code May Not Protect the Guan
summary: Discusses whether the Code of Hermes protects the Guan from Hermetic interference, since they serve hedge-magician kings whom the Order may demand to submit.
quotes: The servants of magicians are the property of those magicians, and may be legitimately targeted.

title: Guan king magic (meceny)
heading: Magic
summary: Community-ceremony magic of the Guan kings: it cannot fail or botch when the traditional formulae are used, and every meceny can perform a fixed set of effects with village help plus two minor effects unique to his tribe.
quotes: The magic of Guan kings is performed with community ceremonies, and cannot fail or botch, provided the ancient and tested formulae are used.
All meceny can perform the following effects, if assisted by their villages:
related: ArM5 p.153 Coerce the Spirits of the Night

title: Canarian dialects and silbo (whistled speech)
heading: Dialects
summary: How well speakers of one Canarian dialect understand another, how silbo (whistled speech) is learned, and how magi can use silbo to extend the range of Voice-range spells.
quotes: A person skilled in any Canarian dialect can communicate with speakers of other Canarian dialects as if his Ability were two points lower.
Spells in silbo are considered to be cast in booming voice.
related: Ancient Magic Chapter 1: The Language of Adam (casting in other languages)

title: Statistics for Guan Weapons
heading: Statistics for Guan Weapons
summary: The adjustment applied to weapons made of stone or volcanic glass instead of metal, with the melee and missile weapon tables for the Guan.
quotes: Those Guan weapons constructed with stone or volcanic glass, in lieu of metal, and have a Damage modifier 2 points lower than usual, to a minimum Damage modifier of +1.

title: Entering the Garden of the Hesperides
heading: Entering the Garden
summary: How characters enter the regio hiding the Garden, its Magic aura, the restriction on entering while facing east, and the effects of the golden apples (a pawn of Creo vis and a reduction in Apparent Age).
quotes: The regio has a Magic aura of 9.
Each apple contains a pawn of Creo vis.

title: Serpent-dryad growth
heading: Serpent-dryads
requires: Dragon tree grown from Ladon's blood
summary: Describes how dragon trees grown from Ladon's blood produce serpent-dryads and the progression by which the serpent gains heads and improves its Might, Soak, Size, Strength, Confidence and mental Characteristics as the tree flowers.
quotes: At each flowering, the serpent gains an extra head.
For every five heads, the creature gains a point of Might and Soak.

title: The Hyperborean Hymns of Apollo (overview)
heading: The Hyperborean Hymns of Apollo
summary: Introduces the hymns, the sacred names taught by Apollo, whose power derives from the Magic realm rather than the Divine.
quotes: although their power derives from the Magic realm, not the Divine.

title: Performing the Hyperborean hymns
heading: Performing the Hymns
requires: Tradition: Hyperborean hymns (The Gift or Virtue: Hyperborean Hymnist)
summary: Each hymn is learned as its own Supernatural Ability, and only Gifted characters or those with the Hyperborean Hymnist Virtue can recite a hymn successfully; Hermetic magi can study discovered hymns only for Insight.
quotes: Only characters with The Gift or with the Virtue Hyperborean Hymnist can ever successfully recite a hymn and gain the supernatural powers it provides.
related: ArM5 p.166 learning multiple Supernatural Abilities

title: Hyperborean New Virtues (Hymnist and Descent)
heading: New Virtues
summary: The character-creation Virtues that grant access to the hymns: Hyperborean Hymnist (a starting hymn with its powers already infused), and Minor and Major Hyperborean Descent (longevity, spirit affinity, a Mythic Blood variant with a bird or flight feat).
quotes: Your character starts with one recited hymn, which confers the Supernatural Ability of [Hymn] 1, and 15 levels of Powers (which have already been infused at the start of play).

title: Supernatural Ability: Hyperborean Hymn
heading: New Supernatural Ability: Hyperborean Hymn
summary: Each hymn is a separate Supernatural Ability: every level gives levels of powers, adds to Soak against the hymn's principles, and can be added to a Lab Total when the hymn is involved in the effect or item.
quotes: For each level of a Hymn Ability, your character gains 15 levels of powers (see below for details).
Hymns may be also used in the laboratory, by adding the Ability to your character's Lab Total if the hymn involves either the effect or item being enchanted.

title: Dead Language: Hyperborean
heading: Dead Language: Hyperborean
summary: The Hyperborean language, understood by spirits and related to Ancient Greek; it aids hymn recitation but is not required, and its alphabet needs a separate level of Artes Liberales.
quotes: everyday usage, poetry, religious usage, talking to spirits.

title: Illumination: Hyperborean Warping
heading: Illumination: Hyperborean Warping
requires: Tradition: Hyperborean hymns (as first and primary magical tradition)
summary: A Gifted character whose primary tradition is the hymns suffers Illumination in place of ordinary Warping or Hermetic Twilight; Hermetic magi are unaffected and still experience Twilight.
quotes: Illumination does not affect Hermetic magi, who always experience Twilight.

title: Apollo's Light: Illumination Control roll
heading: Apollo's Light
summary: Warping gives a Hyperborean wizard an Apollonian Personality Trait; gaining several Warping Points at once forces an Illumination Control roll, and failure transforms the character into an animal or separates the spirit from the body.
quotes: Illumination Control Roll: Stamina + Concentration + highest Hymn Ability score + stress die
Illumination Ease Factor: character's updated Warping Score + number of Warping Points gained + aura + modifiers + stress die

title: Illumination transformation and the Bright Lightening
heading: Illumination: Hyperborean Warping, Continued
summary: What happens while an Illuminated character is transformed, the second Control roll needed to return to human form, and the voluntary Bright Lightening that trades extra Warping for experience in a hymn.
quotes: This transformation lasts for a number of hours equal to the total number of Warping Points the character has.

title: Illumination Example
heading: Illumination Example
summary: A worked example of an Illumination Control roll, including the effect of Descent and infused power levels, and of voluntarily failing the roll.
quotes: Abaris's Warping Score is 8 (223 Warping Points).

title: Reciting the Hymns
heading: Reciting the Hymns
summary: How a hymnist infuses a Power: a season of contemplation, then a recitation total against an Ease Factor derived from the Power's level. Once infused the Power is used at will and invoked with a brief prayer, with no gestures; includes a worked example.
quotes: Hymn Recitation Total: Communication + Hymn Ability + modifiers + aura
Hymn Recitation Ease Factor: (total level of Power(s) + Power level modifiers) / 3

title: Puissant hymns and hymn Affinities
heading: Puissant hymns and hymn Affinities
summary: Affinity with Ability and Puissant Ability can be taken for a hymn; Puissant raises recitation and Soak totals but does not increase the points for Powers.
quotes: Puissant Hymn effectively increases your hymn recitation totals for that hymn, and other totals that may use your character's Hymn Ability score (such as Soak).

title: Apollonian Personality Traits
heading: Apollonian Personality Traits
summary: Guidance on which Personality Traits Apollo favors and disfavors, used for Dutybound characters and Illumination.
quotes: Apollo symbolized a number of virtuous Personality Traits, the most prominent one being Austerity.

title: Finding hymns, the Easy Way
heading: Finding hymns, the Easy Way
summary: A season-long stress roll to track down a hymn teacher, fragment or relic as a shortcut to a full adventure, with outcomes for failure and botch.
quotes: Finding a Hyperborean Hymn Source: Intelligence + Magic Lore + stress die vs. Ease Factor 21

title: Recitation Total Modifiers
heading: Recitation Total Modifiers
summary: Table of modifiers to a hymn recitation total: devotional behavior, distraction, Descent, knowing the language, and honorable or dishonorable Personality Flaws.
quotes: Devotional behavior means spending a season prior to reciting the hymn in activity devoted to the veneration of Apollo.

title: Hymn Powers
heading: Hymn Powers
summary: How hymn Powers are designed: levels are set with the Hermetic guidelines and effect modifiers, the Ease Factor to recite is a fraction of the level, and hymns need no vis or Rituals even for permanent effects.
quotes: The Ease Factor to recite a hymn is determined by dividing the level of the Power by three (round up).

title: New Duration: 19 Years
heading: New Duration: 19 Years
summary: A new Duration for hymn Powers lasting until the stars complete their nineteen-year revolution, one magnitude above Year Duration.
quotes: The power or spell lasts for 19 years, or until the stars complete their 19-year revolution, whichever is the lesser.

title: Learning to Speak Hyperborean
heading: Learning to Speak Hyperborean
summary: Ways a character can acquire the Hyperborean language: similarity to Ancient Greek, decoding paired prayers, or instruction from Hyperborean ghosts and spirits.
quotes: knowing Ancient Greek allows limited understanding of Hyperborean.

title: Gaining New Powers and Improving Existing Ones
heading: Gaining New Powers and Improving Existing Ones
summary: Raising a Hymn Ability grants more levels of powers that can be spent on new Powers or on improving old ones, each requiring a recitation season; includes a worked example.
quotes: Each time you increase one of your character's Hymn Ability scores, he gains 15 additional levels in powers.

title: Gaining More Levels (hymns and vis)
heading: Gaining More Levels
summary: Hymnists can exceed the practical limit on powers per hymn by spending vis during a recitation, one extra level per pawn, with a suggested adjustment for high-vis sagas.
quotes: For each pawn of vis expended during the recitation of a hymn, the character gains one extra level to spend on Powers.

title: The Seven Beautiful Names of Light: principles and invocation
heading: The Seven Beautiful Names of Light
summary: Introduces the seven surviving hymns, the idea of principles (the hymn equivalent of Forms, relevant to Magic Resistance), the Magic Resistance power common to all hymns, and the longer invocation time at night.
quotes: During the nighttime the hymn takes longer to invoke: 15 minutes per point of the Ease Factor.

title: Hymn: Azai (Beautiful Light)
heading: Azai (Beautiful Light)
summary: The hymn of life, authority and vitality, and its list of principles (what its Powers can affect and their related Hermetic Forms for Magic Resistance).
quotes: *Corpus*: birth, the heart, vitality

title: Hymn: Eloure (Fire Delighter)
heading: Eloure (Fire Delighter)
summary: The hymn of emotion, water and fertility, and its principles.
quotes: *Mentem*: emotions, dreams, honesty, maternal urges

title: Hymn: Iaó (Fire Feeler)
heading: Iaó (Fire Feeler)
summary: The hymn of senses, pleasure and beauty, and its principles.
quotes: *Mentem*: affection, attraction, creativity, pleasure

title: Hymn: Óai (Light Breather)
heading: Óai (Light Breather)
summary: The hymn of intellect, animals, secrecy and travel (including the spirit world), and its principles.
quotes: *Animal*: birds, crows, dolphins, grasshoppers, hawks, mice, snakes, swans, wolves

title: Hymn: Pentiterouni (Firewalker)
heading: Pentiterouni (Firewalker)
summary: The hymn of discipline, the body, earth and stern authority, and its principles.
quotes: *Corpus*: aging and growth, bones, the organs and flesh, skin, trembling

title: Hymn: Psyrinpheu (Fire Breather)
heading: Psyrinpheu (Fire Breather)
summary: The hymn of passion, war and victory, and its principles.
quotes: *Corpus*: fevers, the head, muscles, sexuality, stamina, youth

title: Hymn: Semesilam (Encloser, Lightmaker)
heading: Semesilam (Encloser, Lightmaker)
summary: The hymn of the arts, justice, optimism and prosperity, and its principles.
quotes: *Mentem*: benevolence, justice, morality, optimism

title: Hyperborean Choirs (overview)
heading: Hyperborean Choirs
summary: Singing hymns in a choir is the only way to use more than one hymn at once, and requires the Supernatural Ability Ceremony.
quotes: singing hymns in a choir is the only way to use more than one Hyperborean hymn at once.
related: Realms of Power: The Divine p.34 Ceremony

title: Choir Mechanics
heading: Choir Mechanics
summary: How a choir of hymnists produces a one-off free-form effect: a focus character, a storyguide-set Ease Factor, extra level per additional hymn, members adding Communication plus Hymn Ability, a day or more of trance, and a vis cost equal to the Ease Factor.
quotes: Each member of the choir then adds his Communication + Hymn Ability to the focus character's recitation total.
If the effect calls on more than one hymn, increase the level of the Power by 5 for every extra hymn it requires.

title: Choir Recitation Modifier
heading: Choir Recitation Modifier
summary: Table of bonuses to a choir recitation for spending longer than a day performing the hymn, up to a stated maximum.
quotes: This is the maximum bonus possible.

title: Ability: Ceremony (group effort)
heading: Ability: Ceremony
summary: The Supernatural Ability that lets a group combine totals: each participant adds Characteristic plus Ability to the focus character's total, with a leader limiting contributors and a penalty if there is no leader; it can also boost seasonal activities.
quotes: Ceremony Bonus: Characteristic + Ability total of each participant
All participants add their totals of the appropriate Characteristic + Ability to the focus character's total.
related: Realms of Power: The Divine p.36 Ceremony

title: Choir Example
heading: Choir Example
summary: A worked example of six hymnists using a choir to call down a plague, showing the Ease Factor, vis cost and Ceremony Bonus calculation.
quotes: The focus character's recitation total is 8 (Communication 2 + Hymn Iaó 6) with a Ceremony Bonus of 25*

title: Hyperborean Enchantments (relics)
heading: Hyperborean Enchantments
summary: How a hymnist crafts relics: an enchantment total against an Ease Factor from the Powers' level, no vis but Warping instead, one season per Power, no size or material limits, plus the things hymn enchanting cannot do. Includes sample relic powers and how profaning or damage strips Powers.
quotes: Enchantment Total: Intelligence + Hymn Ability + modifiers + aura
Enchantment Ease Factor: (total level of Power(s) + modifiers) / 3
Furthermore, instead of using vis, the Hyperborean enchanter Warps his own body, at a rate of 2 Warping Points for every pawn of vis the enchantment would have needed

title: New Shape and Material Bonuses
heading: New Shape and Material Bonuses
summary: Four new materials with enchanting bonuses available to all characters: Cappadocian Salt, Doum Palm Leaf, Pure Honey and Sun Scarab.
quotes: Cappadocian Salt: +6 purifying effects
Sun Scarab: +4 detect magic

title: Hyperborean breakthroughs (integration targets)
heading: The Breakthrough
requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Hyperborean magic
summary: The minimum breakthrough points required to integrate each aspect of Hyperborean magic (a new Duration, spirit-travel, vis-less permanent magic and enchantment, removing shape, material and size limits, and Ritual effect enchantment), with advice to vary the totals slightly.
quotes: Integrating Vis-less Permanent Magic: 70 breakthrough points
Integrating a New Duration (Minor Breakthrough): 30 breakthrough points
related: Ancient Magic Introduction: Hermetic breakthroughs and Insight

title: Hyperborean Integration Process
heading: Hyperborean Integration Process
requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Hyperborean magic
summary: The five-step process for integrating Hyperborean magic: find a source, gain Insight, incorporate it into a matching effect, research as in the Introduction, and consider the consequences. Each source gives one Insight tied to its most significant Power.
quotes: Each source allows your character to gain one Insight, which permits him to create one specific effect.

title: Hyperborean Insight
heading: Hyperborean Insight
requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Hyperborean magic
summary: Modifiers to the Insight roll from hymn fragments, relics, teachers, knowledge of the Hyperborean language, and combining multiple sources, with the rule that a single source gives Insight only once; includes an example.
quotes: Having only a fragment of a hymn (such as a sacred name or fragments of a prayer string) imposes a –2 penalty on the Insight roll, while a near-complete fragment grants a +2 bonus to the roll.
Having a basic proficiency in Hyperborean grants +1 to the Insight roll for every point the researcher has in the Ability above 4, to a maximum of +3.

title: Consequences of integrating Hyperborean magic
heading: Consequences
requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Hyperborean magic
summary: Storyguide advice on what each Hyperborean breakthrough would change in the Order: a 19-year Duration, safer spirit travel, vis-less spells and enchantment (supplementing vis with Warping), unlimited shape, material and size, and enchanting Ritual effects.
quotes: This Breakthrough would allow the enchantment of magical devices by supplementing vis with Warping Points, at a rate of 2 Warping Points for every pawn of vis that would have been needed.
related: ArM5 p.161 Aegis of the Hearth

title: Locating the Basilica of Ten Thousand Columns
heading: Finding the Basilica
summary: A shortcut season of research to learn where the basilica lies, resolved by an Order of Hermes Lore stress roll; failure wastes the season and a botch gives a false location.
quotes: Locating the Basilica: Intelligence + Order of Hermes Lore + stress die vs. Ease Factor 21

title: The Basilica's Aura
heading: The Basilica's Aura
requires: Visiting the Basilica of Ten Thousand Columns
summary: The varying Magic aura levels across the vale and buildings, the waxing and waning with the moon, small Dominion and Divine auras, and a doubling of aura benefit for certain spirit, divination and disease magic.
quotes: any spells cast or supernatural abilities used that relate to the summoning or control of the dead, divining the future, curing or causing disease, or invoking spirits receive double the benefit from the magical aura.

title: Agyieus Pillars (enchanting bonuses)
heading: Agyieus Pillars
summary: Agyieus pillars sacred to Apollo may be enchanted and give listed shape and material bonuses for spirits, divination, sunlight, disease and protection.
quotes: The pillars may be enchanted, and provide the following shape and material bonuses: +2 invoking or controlling spirits, +3 divining the future, + 3 summoning sunlight, +5 cause or cure disease, and + 5 protection from hostile spirits.

title: The Altars of Alexander the Great (Arcane Connections)
heading: The Altars of Alexander the Great
summary: The altars are linked by dragon lines; casting an Arcane Connection Range spell while touching one treats the other linked shrines, cities and temples as having an Arcane Connection with a bonus multiplier.
quotes: is considered to have an Arcane Connection with a +4 multiplier to the other shrines, cities, or temples connected by the dragon lines.

title: Nekuomanteioi: ghosts as Arcane Connections for necromantic divination
heading: The Nekuomanteioi, Hyperborean Priests of Apollo
summary: Stat block for the oracular ghosts of the basilica, with a necromancer rule at the end: using such a ghost as an Arcane Connection for Intellego spells to look into the past or future makes the spell a Ritual of higher magnitude and inflicts Warping.
quotes: This increases the magnitude of the spell by 4 if looking into the past, or 5 if looking into the hazy and indistinct future.
related: Realms of Power: The Divine p.49 Adjuration

title: Spirit guardians of the basilica (manifesting)
heading: Spirit Guardians
requires: Visiting the Basilica of Ten Thousand Columns
summary: The underworld spirits bound to the basilica may be treated as chthonic and mistaken for Infernal creatures by holiness-sensing Virtues, and can spend Might to manifest in a physical form that can be wounded but not killed.
quotes: All of the spirits here can spend 1 Magic Might point to manifest in physical form (and return to spiritual form at will).
related: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.123 Sense Holiness and Unholiness

title: Hyperborea as a regio
heading: The Legend
summary: Describes Hyperborea as an island in a multi-level regio that cannot be entered by accident (passwords or an invitation are needed), its inhabitants' Supernatural Powers, and Apollo's visit every nineteen years; includes sidebars on famous Hyperboreans and how to get in.
quotes: Hyperborea is an island hidden in a level 7 regio (although at its highest level it extends to a level 10 regio).

title: Detecting and recognising rune magic
heading: Heirlooms and Artifacts
summary: Rune-enchanted objects do not register as magical to Intellego Vim, and active runes are lasting Arcane Connections to the caster, so finding and proving working rune magic takes observation and investigation.
quotes: Because of the way that rune magic changes the nature of its target, objects with active effects do not seem magical to Intellego Vim spells.

title: Dvergar-forged rune items
heading: The Dvergar
requires: Contact with the dvergar of Nithavellir
summary: How the faerie dvergar craft rune items on commission: they can do more than human rune wizards, their items resemble Hermetic devices, they work only for the person they were made for, and the price is set afterwards and carries hidden costs.
quotes: items only function for the person for whom they were crafted, though they may be inherited by a blood relative

title: Hermetic Integration of Rune Magic
heading: Hermetic Integration
requires: Hermetic breakthrough research on Rune Magic
summary: After investigating active rune magic, a magus can integrate it into Hermetic theory (a Major Breakthrough) to gain the Hermetic Rune Magic Virtue and the Rune Magic Ability, and learns the three formulas for inscribing a rune spell. Includes the Enchantment Runes sidebar.
quotes: (a Major Breakthrough requiring 45 breakthrough points), producing the new Hermetic Rune Magic Virtue, described below.
There are three ways to formulate a rune spell.

title: Enchantment Runes
heading: Enchantment Runes
summary: How magi with Hermetic Rune Magic invent enchanted devices using the Rune Duration and Inscription Target, and the bonus available to Verditius magi who have the Elder Verditius Runes Mystery.
quotes: they must inscribe the runes onto the item as part of investing the effect.
related: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.127

title: Hermetic Rune Magic: Rune Duration and Inscription Target
heading: New Virtue
summary: The extended mechanic behind the Hermetic Rune Magic Virtue: the Rune Duration and Inscription Target, how and how fast runes are inscribed, casting-total modifiers for hiding or omitting the name and description, the craft-roll alternative, and the drawbacks (a lasting Arcane Connection and a Warping Point for the target).
quotes: This Duration is equivalent to Moon, adding three magnitudes to a spell's base level.
If the magus does not inscribe his name into the inscription, he receives a –5 penalty.

title: Ability: Rune Magic
heading: New Ability: Rune Magic
requires: Rune Magic study or Virtue: Hermetic Rune Magic
summary: The Arcane Ability covering knowledge of runes: their symbolism, formulating and encrypting rune-script, and copying books on rune magic.
quotes: hiding runes, identifying rune magic, runes associated with a particular Art.

title: Rune Magic and Creo Spells
heading: Rune Magic and Creo Spells
summary: Special rules for Creo with rune magic: created targets need the runes on an Arcane Connection to the target and are only created if it does not already exist, and healing runes take the place of natural healing while they remain on the target.
quotes: If the effect creates a target, the runes must be written on an Arcane Connection to that target, and the target is only created if it does not already exist.
